title: Grateful Dead Live at Harpur College on 1970-05-02
source: reel> cass > cass Nak Dr-1 > Lynx Studio Interface at 32 bit float / 96 kHz Weiss Saracon for BRC to 24 bit / 96 kHz by Jamie Waddell

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with solid audio despite occasional cuts, capturing a legendary 1970 performance highlighted by Cryptical Envelopment and Cosmic Charlie
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this show as possibly the finest 1970 Grateful Dead concert, praising the acoustic set and the soaring performances of Cryptical Envelopment into Cosmic Charlie. The soundboard source delivers generally good clarity with strong monitor balance, though a few reviewers note occasional mistakes and cuts in the tape.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly enthusiastic 5‑star comments about the musical performance outweigh minor complaints about tape glitches, yielding a high combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear with strong monitor balance; some reviewers mention occasional cuts, mistakes, and sound issues but overall the audio is listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert is celebrated for its powerful acoustic set and seamless transition into electric jams, with many fans calling it the finest performance of 1970.
